Personality: Paxter Redwin was majestic and valued the fleet, believing that sea power must be supported by discipline and supplies. He is sensitive to disrespect, but has the courage to face a naval battle.
Background: Paxter is the Earl of the Arbor and one of the helmsmen of the Redwin fleet. The power of the Redwyne family comes from ports, vineyards and ships. Every choice he makes will affect both the river nobles and maritime trade routes.
